Advanced Filters (Optional): You can target specific types of users by adding a filter. • `/banall bots` - Targets ONLY bots. • `/banall deleted` - Targets ONLY deleted accounts. *(Filters work with kickall and unbanall too)* Remote Execution: You can run these commands from the Bot's DM or another group by adding a Chat ID or Username! • `/banall -1001234567890` • `/banall @MyTargetGroup -test bots` Dry-Run Mode (Test): Want to see who will be affected without actually banning them? Use `-test`. • `/banall -test` • `/banall -test bots` Rules: - These commands must be sent directly in the group you want to manage. - The Bot must have the `Ban Users` privilege. - These commands are strictly limited to Sudo Users and the Bot Owner.
